_meta.note: Guardrail models, datasets and results. Primary sources only: AA article RSC records, Red Hat article text (Playwright), GA Guard and TrueFoundry posts, RAIL Guard PDF, and four papers read by parallel readers with every row machine-verified against the pdftotext line. Secondary pages (trussed.ai, generalanalysis guide, saranyan.com, aidefense.dev x2, techtimes, aisparkup x2, ADS mirror) were read as pointers only. DeepRails: relative gains only (+37-53% vs Bedrock on 60 pairs), no absolute values — not stored. Vendor-run comparisons (GA, TrueFoundry, AA, Red Hat, papers) are on their own benchmark ids or *_rerun_<paper> channels.

benchmarks.name: CS-Guard base-LLM ASR (internal-type guardrail = alignment) — text-to-code level 1 (base TTP prompts, no jailbreak)
benchmarks.description: Attack success rate of the base code LLM itself (no external guardrail), lower is better. Split: text-to-code level 1 (base TTP prompts, no jailbreak). CS-Guard (arXiv 2609.09798, Li/Guo/Nguyen, Adelaide Univ., 2026). Text-to-code: 1000 CyberSecEval MITRE-TTP malware prompts (level 1 base; level 2 = 7 jailbreaks + FSA, 1000 prompts each); code-to-code: 331 malware code prompts (160 completion from RedCode-Gen, 80 infilling + 91 translation from RMCBench). 5 samples/prompt, attack counted successful if any response labelled bad by majority-vote LLM labeler (96.8/93.8/93.7% agreement with human labels). For SmoothLLM the value is % of successful base-LLM attacks detected. Higher is better. Split: text-to-code level 2, UCAR jailbreak. CS-Guard (arXiv 2609.09798, Li/Guo/Nguyen, Adelaide Univ., 2026). Text-to-code: 1000 CyberSecEval MITRE-TTP malware prompts (level 1 base; level 2 = 7 jailbreaks + FSA, 1000 prompts each); code-to-code: 331 malware code prompts (160 completion from RedCode-Gen, 80 infilling + 91 translation from RMCBench). 5 samples/prompt, attack counted successful if any response labelled bad by majority-vote LLM labeler (96.8/93.8/93.7% agreement with human labels). License CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (FSA data). Guardrail / setting: SmoothLLM.
